sources.quote: Final message - 3 Day Startup - Skip to main content Close Search Menu Our Impact Financials Dear 3 Day Startup participants, community members, and supporters, 3 Day Startup has decided to cease operations as of May 2023. To reach this decision, the board of directors has carefully weighed the operational efforts and resources required to continue. There are many opportunities to continue supporting entrepreneurs, but we plan to separately pursue these opportunities. Over the 15 years since 3DS was founded, we have worked on missions aimed to enable entrepreneurs through many different activities and in many different settings: Early in our history, we aimed to enable university entrepreneurs, equipping them with the best practices of starting companies and giving them the confidence to start their own ventures. We engaged with over 150 universities world-wide in this effort, and have enabled more than 20,000 university students to start their own companies, become community leaders, and to deliver great products and services.
